en:The Cycle of Life/Funeral Service:2.en: While on the way to the grave, say:

parts.text: After the funeral, the following is said, except on days on which Taḥanun
parts.en: After the funeral, the following is said, except on days on which Taḥanun is omitted, or after nightfall. Some say the following before the funeral.

parts.text: is omitted, or after nightfall. Some say the following before the funeral.

en:The Cycle of Life/Funeral Service:17.en: to proclaim that the LORD is upright; He is my Rock, in whom there is no wrong.

en:The Cycle of Life/Funeral Service:18.en: The LORD has given and the LORD has taken away: blessed be the name of the LORD.

en:The Cycle of Life/Funeral Service:19.en: He is compassionate; He forgives iniquity and does not destroy. Repeatedly He suppresses His anger, not rousing His full wrath.

en:The Cycle of Life/Funeral Service:20.en: The following Kaddish, said by the mourners, requires the presence of a minyan.

parts.text: Magnified and sanctified may His great name be,
in the world that will in future be renewed,

reviving the dead and raising them up to eternal life.
He will rebuild the city of Jerusalem and in it reestablish His Temple.
He will remove alien worship from the earth and restore to its place the worship of Heaven.
Then the Holy One,

will reign in His sovereignty and splendor.
May it be in your lifetime and in your days,
and in the lifetime of all the house of Israel,
May His great name be blessed for ever and all time.

uplifted and lauded
be the name of the Holy One,

praise and consolation
uttered in the world – and say: Amen.

en:The Cycle of Life/Funeral Service:25.en: Bow, take three steps back, as if taking leave of the Divine Presence, then bow, first left, then right, then center, while saying:

en:The Cycle of Life/Funeral Service:27.en: After the funeral, those present form two rows, the mourners pass between them, and the following is said to them:

en:The Cycle of Life/Funeral Service:28.en: May the Almighty comfort you among the other mourners of Zion and Jerusalem.

en:The Cycle of Life/Funeral Service:30.en: May you have no further grief

en:The Cycle of Life/Funeral Service:31.en: Some have the custom to pick blades of grass and throw them over their shoulders, saying:

en:The Cycle of Life/Funeral Service:32.en: May they of the city grow like the grass of the earth

en:The Cycle of Life/Funeral Service:35.en: After leaving the cemetery, it is customary to wash one's hands and say:

en:The Cycle of Life/Funeral Service:36.en: He will destroy death for ever, and the LORD God will wipe away the tears from all faces and remove the reproach of His people from the whole earth, for the LORD has spoken.
